BANKING CAMPAIGN INTELLIGENCE · HYBRID QUANTUM / CLASSICAL

Smarter decisions.
Measured impact.

Q-BIRD turns customer signals into a focused, explainable banking campaign plan. It connects machine-learning predictions, constrained resource allocation and quantum probability simulation in one auditable workflow.

A research prototype for campaign planning. Not a production banking or credit-decision system.
Precision with perspective.
Predict · Optimize · Simulate · Verify
Q-BIRD / 01
◉
01 / Predict with evidence

Rank the 100 unseen customers using a model trained on labeled campaign data, with validation metrics that make uncertainty visible.

⌘
02 / Allocate with constraints

Choose exactly six candidates from the top ten while respecting contact budget and operational capacity, then compare with an exact classical baseline.

⚛
03 / Simulate and verify

Encode the selected probabilities into a six-qubit circuit model and compare finite-shot estimates against exact probability and Monte Carlo checks.
